description: Implementation of SimpleSessionNotifier class for managing QUIC session data, retransmissions, and control frames in tests.

classes.name: SimpleSessionNotifier
classes.description: A class for simulating and testing QUIC session behavior, including data transmission, retransmissions, and control frame handling.

classes.name: StreamState
classes.description: Represents the state of a QUIC stream, including data counters and fin flags.

methods.name: WriteOrBufferData
methods.description: Writes or buffers stream data for a given stream ID.

methods.name: OnStreamDataConsumed
methods.description: Updates stream state after data has been acknowledged as consumed.

methods.name: WriteCryptoData
methods.description: Writes or buffers crypto handshake data.

methods.name: WriteOrBufferRstStream
methods.description: Buffers or sends a RST_STREAM frame.

methods.name: WriteOrBufferWindowUpate
methods.description: Buffers or sends a WINDOW_UPDATE frame.

methods.name: WriteOrBufferPing
methods.description: Buffers or sends a PING frame.

methods.name: WriteOrBufferAckFrequency
methods.description: Buffers or sends an ACK_FREQUENCY frame.

methods.name: NeuterUnencryptedData
methods.description: Acknowledges all unencrypted crypto data.

methods.name: OnCanWrite
methods.description: Attempts to retransmit lost data and send new data when writable.

methods.name: StreamBytesSent
methods.description: Returns total bytes sent on all streams.

methods.name: StreamBytesToSend
methods.description: Returns total bytes pending to send on all streams.

methods.name: OnFrameAcked
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment of a frame.

methods.name: OnFrameLost
methods.description: Handles loss of a frame.

methods.name: RetransmitFrames
methods.description: Retransmits specified frames.

methods.name: IsFrameOutstanding
methods.description: Checks if a frame is still outstanding.

methods.name: HasUnackedCryptoData
methods.description: Checks if there is unacknowledged crypto data.

methods.name: HasUnackedStreamData
methods.description: Checks if there is unacknowledged stream data.

methods.name: OnControlFrameAcked
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment of a control frame.

methods.name: OnControlFrameLost
methods.description: Handles loss of a control frame.

methods.name: IsControlFrameOutstanding
methods.description: Checks if a control frame is still outstanding.

methods.name: RetransmitLostControlFrames
methods.description: Retransmits lost control frames.

methods.name: RetransmitLostCryptoData
methods.description: Retransmits lost crypto data.

methods.name: RetransmitLostStreamData
methods.description: Retransmits lost stream data.

methods.name: WriteBufferedCryptoData
methods.description: Sends buffered crypto data.

methods.name: WriteBufferedControlFrames
methods.description: Sends buffered control frames.

methods.name: HasBufferedControlFrames
methods.description: Checks if there are buffered control frames.

methods.name: HasBufferedStreamData
methods.description: Checks if there is buffered stream data.

methods.name: StreamIsWaitingForAcks
methods.description: Checks if a stream is waiting for acknowledgments.

methods.name: StreamHasBufferedData
methods.description: Checks if a stream has buffered data to send.

methods.name: HasLostStreamData
methods.description: Checks if there is lost stream data pending retransmission.
